name: Beetle, Giant Flash
body:
Flash Beetle
CR 1/2

XP 200
N Small vermin
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 natural, +2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 6 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +2, Will +2
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (poor)
Melee bite +3 (1d4+2)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 15, Con 15, Int —, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 13 (21 vs. trip)
Skills Fly +0
SQ flash

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Flash (Ex)

A flash beetle can create a bright flash of light once an hour. When a flash beetle does so, all creatures in a 10-foot burst must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1d3 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, cluster (2–6) or colony (7–12)
Treasure none
